name: usage-relay
description: Watches provider usage and relays work along a configured chain of models, with a written handoff at every move.

chain_file.title: Chain file
chain_file.description: Path to the chain JSON. Empty uses %USERPROFILE%\.claude\usage-relay\chain.json. There is no default chain: without a readable file the relay does nothing.

handoff_file.title: Handoff file name
handoff_file.description: The file the outgoing model writes in the project root, and the incoming model reads.

terminal.title: Terminal program
terminal.description: The executable used to open the successor session. `wt` is Windows Terminal, `preview` is Windows Terminal Preview, or give a full path.

poll_seconds.title: Poll period (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often an enabled session reads its meters.

enabled.title: Enabled by default
enabled.description: Whether a new session starts enabled. Off by default; /relay enable turns the current session on.

deepseek_api_key.title: DeepSeek API key
deepseek_api_key.description: Used only for the DeepSeek balance check when DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not set in the environment. Stored in secure storage.
